architecture.name: atomic_mlp_tanh_geant4
architecture.note: The tanh stack with the Geant4 atomic response added; exported to TRECH as the atomic rung (inputs read from a live Geant4 probe) and the Geant4-fed cascade source.

note.label_source: NIST ASD neutral-atom lines (g_k*A_ki weighted) reached via PubChem element records
note.inputs: PubChem periodic-table facts, NIST ground level as reported by PubChem, and the Geant4 atomic response (mean excitation energy, per-atom photo-absorption cross sections; read from a live Geant4 material probe in TRECH)
note.scope: Line-strength shape on 200-1000 nm (40 bins); not a plasma emission spectrum, no level populations or instrument response.

calibration.source: out-of-fold predictions of the ranking k-fold CV on the training split

out_of_group.source: leave-one-chemical-group-out CV on the training split
